text: I have been waiting on this line for almost one hour now and nobody is picking. My daughter is 8 years. Since evening she has these small small red and purple dots on her legs and tummy, some are looking like bruise. I pressed a glass on them as my wife said, they are not fading at all, they are still there clear clear. She is weeing normally, no problem there. Please somebody should get back to me abeg, I don't want to be waiting all night.
